song.lyrics:
[V1] As I lay upon my bed, Lord I remember days gone by When I was young and healthy the gleam was in my eyes Hair that was black as raven now has turned to grey In this dark and dreary world Lord I don't want to stay
[C1] Walk with me through this valley Help me Lord when I can't sleep Hold my hand through the fight Comfort me when I am weak Let me feel your Holy Spirit when the Jordan I see I'm waiting for you Lord guide my feet
[V2] I'm thinking of the blessings and all you've done for me The places that I've been Lord and what my eyes have seen This old world and all its beauty I know cannot compare To what you have waiting for me when I get over there
song.title: I'm Waiting for You Lord
